review_notes: [review] The article discusses Rett syndrome and summarizes genetic findings; it includes explicit human variants (e.g., MECP2 c.880C>T p.Arg294X; CDKL5 c.2112C>A p.Tyr704X; FOXG1 c.689G>A p.Arg230His) presented in figures and tables, indicating reported human mutations. Thus it provides variant-level information in a review format.
